page.$description: Tokens of `page`: its skip link, and the layout of its navigation and content.

max-inline-size.$description: The largest inline size of the body: the navigation and the content.

navigation-inline-size.$description: The inline size of the navigation, beside the content.

content-min-inline-size.$description: The smallest inline size of the content beside the navigation: narrower, the navigation goes above it.

gap.$description: Space between the navigation and the content.

padding-inline.$description: Space at the sides of the body.

padding-block.$description: Space above and below the body.

skip-link-background-color.$description: Background of the skip link, while it has the focus.

skip-link-padding.$description: Space around the text of the skip link.

focus-ring-offset.$description: Space between the element and its focus ring.
